To clarify the date of the acquisition of the annuity identified in paragraph 13 of Part VII: the annuity 1s to replace the pension that is identified m Part I. Upon

the plan. 1 chose to convert the pension to a retirement annuity. 1 made the declaration to convert the pension to a retirement annuity in November 2016, but |

understand the annuity was actually purchased in 2017.
